question: What can I do with trip items?

sections.title: Add trip items directly
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to create a personal item directly inside one trip without going through a dictionary page first.
items: Click the Dashboard toolbar button, expand the Trip section and click on the Trips link
Select the trip you want to work in.
Open the Trip section again and select Items.
Click the Add button with the plus icon. The Add Trip Item form opens.
Enter the item name. Add category, notes, units, value, and an optional bag if you already know where the item should be packed.
Click Submit.
Plantour saves the item in that trip and returns you to the Trip Items list.
sections.afterHtml: This creates a trip-specific item. It belongs to that trip, not to your reusable dictionary.

sections.title: Copy items from your Items dictionary into a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the item already exists in your reusable Items dictionary and you want to include it in one trip.
items: Open the toolbar Dictionary menu and select Items.
Open the actions bar in the page header and choose the target option.
Choose the trip you want to send items to.
Narrow the list to the items you want by filtering or sorting if needed.
For the exact workflow of target, filter, and sort tools, see How do I filter, sort and target entities?.
To copy one item, click the add button on that row. To copy many visible items at once, use the page-level plus button.
Plantour copies the selected dictionary items into the chosen trip`s Trip Items list.

sections.title: Copy template items into a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to start from ready-made template suggestions and place them into your personal trip item list.
items: Open the toolbar Dictionary menu and select Template items.
Open the target option in the actions bar and choose the trip you want to work in.
Filter the template list by Template, Activity, Temperature Range, Age, Category, or Name until only the items you want are shown.
If you need a refresher on how bulk targeting works, read How do I filter, sort and target entities?.
To copy one visible template item, click the add button on that row. To copy many visible template items at once, use the page-level plus button.
Plantour copies the selected template items into that trip`s Trip Items list.

sections.title: Copy AI recommendations into a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want Plantour to generate item suggestions from your trip description and then place the useful ones into your personal trip item list.
items: Open the toolbar Dictionary menu and select AI prompts.
Type a prompt or choose one of the recent prompts from the dropdown list.
Describe the trip clearly, such as destination, weather, activities, trip length, or traveler age, then click Ask AI.
When the recommendations appear, choose the trip you want as the target.
If you want to narrow or batch the results first, use filtering and sorting. For the exact target and bulk-copy workflow, see How do I filter, sort and target entities?.
To copy one recommendation, click the add button on that row. To copy many visible recommendations at once, use the page-level plus button.
Plantour copies the selected AI recommendations into that trip`s Trip Items list.

sections.title: Update a trip item
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to change a trip item that already belongs to one trip.
items: Open Trip > Items for the selected trip.
Select the trip item you want to change so it is highlighted.
Click the Update button with the pencil icon. The Edit Trip Item form opens.
Change the fields you want to update, such as name, category, notes, units, value, or selected bag.
Click Submit.
Plantour saves the updated trip item and returns you to the trip item list.
sections.afterHtml: Updating a trip item changes only that trip item. It does not change the original item in your reusable Items dictionary.

sections.title: Delete a trip item
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to remove an item from one trip.
items: Open Trip > Items for the selected trip.
Select the trip item you want to remove so it is highlighted.
Click the Delete button with the trash icon.
Confirm the deletion.
Plantour removes the item from that trip`s Trip Items list.
sections.afterHtml: Deleting a trip item affects only that trip. It does not delete the original item from your reusable Items dictionary. To continue with bag-related workflows, read What options do I have to pack the trip items?.
